# Writing

This plugin groups related workflows under one installation. Open the matching
contract before acting; do not answer from this index alone.

- [Document Writing](../../references/modules/document-writing.md)
  Write, rewrite, and audit publication-ready documents for GitHub repositories and Steam Workshop. Use for README architecture, heading icons, evidence-first structure, stable anchors, Steam BBCode Workshop descriptions, bilingual delivery, and final syntax lint.
- [Localization](../../references/modules/localization.md)
  Translate game CSV rows into 13 fixed locales with consistent terminology, intact BBCode, correct CSV escaping, and a clean importable output. Use for game localization batches and locale audits.

Load only the supporting references the task needs. The plugin is self-contained;
do not look for a shared AzSkills entry or for other plugins in the catalog.
